description: The plot illustrates how a metric labeled “Similarity” varies across model “Layer” for four language-pair series. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0 to 23 with numeric ticks shown at regular intervals of 2 (0, 2, 4, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to about 0.45 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.05 increments. Four solid lines without visible point markers are shown: a dark red line (legend text obscured) starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to about 0.10 by layer 2, climbs sharply to a local peak around 0.26 at layer 6, drops to roughly 0.16–0.17 around layers 7–8, stays near 0.16–0.18 through about layers 9–13, declines to around 0.12–0.13 by layers 15–16, reaches about 0.08–0.10 around layers 18–21, then increases sharply to roughly 0.18 at layer 22 and ends near 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line labeled “en&es” begins around 0.06 at layer 0, increases to about 0.09–0.10 by layers 2–3, rises to a peak near 0.24 at layer 6, drops to about 0.15 at layer 7, remains around 0.15–0.18 through roughly layers 8–13, declines to about 0.11–0.12 by layers 15–16, falls to around 0.06–0.08 by layers 18–21, then rises to about 0.14 at layer 22 and ends near 0.27 at layer 23. The green line labeled “en&el” starts near 0.045 at layer 0, rises to about 0.08 at layer 2, dips slightly around layers 3–4 (near 0.055–0.065), increases to about 0.15 at layer 6, drops to roughly 0.095 at layer 7, climbs gradually to around 0.14–0.15 by layers 11–12, declines to about 0.09 by layers 15–16, reaches about 0.05–0.06 around layers 18–21, then increases to about 0.12 at layer 22 and ends near 0.30 at layer 23. The purple line labeled “en&bn” begins around 0.035 at layer 0, rises to about 0.07 at layer 2, dips around layers 3–4 (near 0.05–0.06), increases to about 0.14 at layer 6, drops to roughly 0.09–0.10 at layer 7, climbs to around 0.13–0.14 by layers 11–12, declines to about 0.085–0.09 by layers 15–16, falls to roughly 0.05–0.06 around layers 18–21, then rises to about 0.14 at layer 22 and ends near 0.29 at layer 23.
